_source: NASS, 'Summary: State Election Canvassing Timeframes and Recount Thresholds', updated October 2024, https://www.nass.org/sites/default/files/reports/summary-canvass-certification-laws-oct2024.pdf. Each entry quotes the summary's sentence and gives its citation as the summary prints it.
_use: Read by app/live_results/certified.py for a state whose certification Civitas can't read: once the last day the law gives the state to certify its federal results has passed, and the state's own live count stopped changing on or before that day, the count is taken as the certified one, dated the deadline. A deadline is {days: N} after the election, {weekday: MON..SUN, nth: N} (the Nth such weekday after the election), {month: M, weekday, nth} (the Nth such weekday of month M). Only states whose live count Civitas reads are listed; a state with no fixed deadline for its federal canvass (Rhode Island's, Indiana's for Congress) or none in the summary (West Virginia's) is not.

AR.quote: County officials canvass local election returns no later than 15 days after the election. The Secretary of State (in the presence of the Governor) conducts the state canvass for state and federal offices no later than 30 days after county canvass deadline.

CO.quote: The Secretary of State canvasses election results no later than the 27th day after the election.

FL.quote: The Governor, and two members of the Governor’s Cabinet, canvass and certify election results for state and federal and multi-county offices and statewide issues on the 14th day after the election.

GA.quote: The Secretary of State must canvass and certify election results for state and federal offices no later than 17 days after the election.

ID.quote: The Secretary of State, State Controller, and State Treasurer meet within 15 days after the election to canvass and certify election results for state and federal offices.

IA.quote: The Governor, Secretary of State, State Auditor, State Treasurer, and Secretary of Agriculture meet to canvass and declare election results for state and federal offices no later than 27 days after the election.

LA.quote: The Secretary of state canvasses and certifies results federal offices on or before the 14th day after the election.

MD.quote: The Secretary of State, the Comptroller, the State Treasurer, the Clerk of the Court of Appeals, and the Attorney General meet within 30 days of the election to canvass and certify results for state and federal offices.

MN.quote: The Secretary of State, two State Supreme Court Judges, and two District Court Judges meet on the 3rd Tuesday following the election to canvass and certify election results for state and federal offices.

MT.quote: The State Auditor, the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, and the Superintendent of Public Instruction meet within 27 days of the election to canvass and certify election results for state and federal offices.

NE.quote: The Governor, Secretary of State, Auditor of Public Accounts, State Treasurer, and Attorney General meet on the 4th Monday after the Election to canvass and determine election results for state and federal offices (except state executive offices).

NM.statute: New Mexico Statutes 1-13-3; 13-13; 13-15; 13-16; New Mexico Constitution 6-33
NM.quote: The Governor, Secretary of State, and Chief Justice of the State Supreme Court meet on the 3rd Tuesday after the election to canvass and declare election results for state and federal elections.

ND.quote: The State Canvassing Board meets no later than 17 days after the election to canvass and certify election results for state and federal offices.

SC.quote: The Commission must complete the canvass and certify results within 15 days, or within 5 days for results of presidential electors.

SD.quote: The Governor, the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, and the Secretary of State meet within 7 days of the election to canvass election results for state and federal offices.

TX.statute: Texas Code 67-003; 012; 016; Texas Constitution Article 4, Section 3
TX.quote: The Governor conducts the state canvass for state and federal offices (except Governor and Lt. Gov.) no earlier than the 18th day, and no later than the 33rd day, after the election.

UT.quote: The State Auditor, the State Treasurer, and the Attorney General meet on the 4th Monday of November to canvass and determine election results for state and federal offices.

VT.quote: One week after the election, the Secretary of State, and the chair of the state committee of each major political party, canvass and certify election results for state and federal offices.

VA.quote: The State Board of Elections meets by the first Monday in December to canvass and ascertain election results for state and federal offices.

WA.quote: The Secretary of State canvasses and certifies election results for state and federal offices no later than the 30th day after the election.
